payload.hypothesis: GraphicWin owns an optional Buffer through its +0xA08 field, currently erased to an integer poCanvas_. Recover its typed pointer and allocation/deletion lifecycle together with on_size and Buffer::resize. The on_size seed resizes the embedded buffer where the original uses the pointed-to buffer, and supplies the address of the palette-pointer global where the original loads PaletteActive. Preserve the two receivers and pointer-versus-object distinction instead of copying that seed body.
